reason: TISDiSS exposes inference depth as a speed/performance control for speech source separation without retraining an additional model, making it a direct acoustic inference-scaling comparator.

The paper combines frozen multimodal LLMs with XAI evidence to generate training-free, decision-grounded explanations for speech deepfake detection; page-level review must resolve the evidence interface and PartialSpoof dependency.

OpenOmni is an end-to-end speech, emotion, retrieval and LLM integration harness with latency and accuracy benchmarking, useful as an experiment-environment instrument despite unresolved repository licensing.

Patched MOA directly compares Best-of-N, mixture aggregation and MCTS as model-agnostic inference optimizers without fine-tuning, providing an executable transfer baseline for candidate generation and selection.
ACING uses actor-critic feedback to optimize instructions against black-box models and can clarify which external reward-optimization mechanisms transfer without updating the frozen target model.

MiniMind-O supplies a small inspectable speech-native omni stack with frozen speech/image encoders, streaming speech output, released checkpoints and training data; it is a candidate low-cost environment carrier.

LiViBench is an omnimodal benchmark whose interactive livestream inputs explicitly combine audio, speech, video and real-time comments, potentially extending local evaluation coverage beyond static audio tasks.
Tool Attention performs dynamic tool gating and lazy schema loading at runtime, a transferable budget-allocation mechanism for selectively exposing expensive evaluators or tools.
AutoResearchBench provides an open environment for evaluating complex scientific literature discovery and is directly relevant to validating the planned research knowledge layer.
OPTS uses explicit bandit selection among prompt-design strategies, supplying a compact reward-guided policy-selection analogue with released experimental code.
Phoenix-VAD isolates streaming semantic endpoint detection as a plug-and-play stopping controller for full-duplex speech interaction, directly informing stop/continue actions.
Explain-Query-Test turns explanation/comprehension discrepancy into an inference-time self-evaluation signal and provides an open comparator for self-verification reliability.
EnvBench evaluates automated environment setup and exposes reproducible environment failures, directly supporting the reproduction-first experiment phase.
EET converts prior execution traces into early-termination decisions with measured cost savings and negligible task loss, a direct stopping-policy transfer reference.
s1 couples supervised fine-tuning with runtime budget forcing. It is useful boundary evidence for separating a reusable test-time controller from the training investment that enabled it.
VoxPrivacy contributes a speaker-aware speech-language-model safety benchmark and reports a broad conditional-privacy failure, useful negative evidence for verifier and identity-aware control.
Curie supplies an open system for rigorous automated scientific experimentation, relevant to experiment planning, execution evidence and reproducibility boundaries in Stage 2.
EnvScaler programmatically synthesizes tool-interactive environments for agents and can inform scalable construction of bounded evaluation environments.
The paper derives a training-free dysarthria-severity measurement from frozen HuBERT phonological subspaces across ten corpora, a candidate acoustic reward or diagnostic instrument.
SpeechRole provides direct speech-to-speech evaluation of interaction, expressiveness and role fidelity and documents gaps between open and closed speech agents.
Counterfactual Activation Editing applies post-hoc inference-time interventions to correct prosody and pronunciation in a pretrained TTS model without retraining.
